# Flutter Leaf Component Library - LLM Documentation

This index lists Leaf Component documentation pages formatted for LLMs.
Each link points to a standalone Markdown file under the /llms path.

## Design Tokens

- [Colors](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/common/tokens/colors.md): Semantic color tokens for brand, surface, state, and interactive colors
- [Typography](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/common/tokens/typography.md): Material Design 3 type scale with 15 text styles
- [Spacing](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/common/tokens/spacing.md): Consistent spacing scale from xs (2) to xxxl (32)
- [Elevation](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/common/tokens/elevation.md): Shadow depth scale for layered UI
- [Radius](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/common/tokens/radius.md): Border radius tokens from none to full
- [Duration](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/common/tokens/duration.md): Animation duration presets

## Theme

- [Theme System](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/common/theme/system.md): InheritedWidget-based theme propagation with LeafTheme
- [Theme Data](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/common/theme/data.md): Central theme configuration with design tokens and 23 component themes
- [Context Extensions](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/common/theme/context.md): BuildContext extensions for quick theme access

## Atoms

- [Text](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/atoms/text.md): Themed text widget with CJK underline workaround
- [Icon](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/atoms/icon.md): Icon wrapper with theme integration
- [Badge](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/atoms/badge.md): Notification badge indicator
- [Button](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/atoms/button.md): Interactive button with loading states and lock gesture
- [CheckBox](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/atoms/checkbox.md): Single checkbox and multi-selection checkbox group
- [Radio](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/atoms/radio.md): Single radio button and radio button group
- [Switch](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/atoms/switch.md): Toggle switch widget
- [Chip](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/atoms/chip.md): Single chip and multi-chip container
- [Slider](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/atoms/slider.md): Single value slider and range selection slider
- [Indicator](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/atoms/indicator.md): Loading indicator and page indicators (circle, rectangle)
- [Skeleton](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/atoms/skeleton.md): Shimmer loading skeleton placeholder
- [Animated](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/atoms/animated.md): Animation wrappers (bounce, expand, fade, flip, rotate, scale)
- [Image](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/atoms/image.md): Image widgets (asset, cached, network, avatar, memory)
- [Painter](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/atoms/painter.md): Custom timeline painter
- [Size](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/atoms/size.md): Widget size measurement utility

## Molecules

- [TextField](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/molecules/textfield.md): Themed text input field with controller
- [RatingBar](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/molecules/ratingbar.md): Star rating component
- [AppBar](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/molecules/appbar.md): Application bar with back button and actions
- [Tabs](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/molecules/tabs.md): Tab navigation bar and tab content view

## Organisms

- [Accordion](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/organisms/accordion.md): Expandable/collapsible content sections
- [Dialog](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/organisms/dialog.md): Alert dialogs and specialized picker dialogs
- [BottomSheet](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/organisms/bottomsheet.md): Modal bottom sheet
- [Toast](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/organisms/toast.md): Toast notification messages
- [Notification](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/organisms/notification.md): Push notification display widget
- [Calendar](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/organisms/calendar.md): Full calendar view with month/week navigation
- [Page](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/organisms/page.md): Page view with indicators and auto-page support
- [Scroll](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/organisms/scroll.md): List view, grid view, and scroll view variants
- [Photo](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/organisms/photo.md): Photo album and photo list with LRU caching
- [Picker](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/organisms/picker.md): Date and time picker widgets
- [Grid](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/organisms/grid.md): Staggered grid layout

## Templates

- [Screen](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/templates/screen.md): Base screen widgets with keep-alive support
- [Layout](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/templates/layout.md): App layout template
- [NavigationBar](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/templates/navigationbar.md): Bottom tab bar scaffold with controller
- [PopScope](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/templates/popscope.md): App close handler on back press

## Shared

- [Utilities](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/llms/leaf_component/v2/shared/shared.md): InkWell effect and lock gesture detector
